call_points.text: Management expects core states to grow at 13 plus/minus percent and focus states at upwards of 20% in FY27.
Company implemented a 3% price hike in April to manage edible oil and packaging material inflation.
Planned capex for FY27 is close to ₹100 crores, primarily for a new sweets factory in Bikaner.
E-commerce and quick-commerce channel grew over 100% and now account for 3% of overall business.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Office of Principal Commissioner CGST and Central Excise Commissionerate Jaipur has issued Demand Order under Section 74 of the Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 towards the Goods and Services Tax of Rs. 5,53,83,313, along with the applicable interest and equivalent penalty thereo. The Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka in the writ proceedings has already stayed the proceedings in the said matter in the case of Company, however, stay order passed by the High Court has not been considered. The Company is taking further legal steps in this matter.

tax_litigation.status: On April 04, 2025, the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka has further stayed the proceedings in the said matter until the next date of hearing.

guidance.statement: Core states growth targeted at 13 plus/minus percent and focus states at upwards of 20% for FY27.
FY27 EBITDA margin targeted at 13-13.5%, including PLI
Overall growth target of 15% plus this year
Ad spend targeted at about 2% of sales for the year
Sweets to grow 12-13% and gifting 17-18% over Q2 and Q3 combined
Core markets to grow 13-15%; UP budgeted at 30% plus
15% operating margin is a three-year target, with at least 50 bps improvement year-on-year

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Packaged Foods

operating_notes.text: Bikaji USA turnover reached $2,620,309 for the period ended March 31, 2026.
E-commerce and quick-commerce channels reached 3% of overall business with nearly 100% growth.
Direct reach stood at 3,70,000 outlets plus at the end of Q1FY27, with 17,000 outlets added in the quarter.
Quick commerce grew upwards of 100% in Q1FY27, and the channel is a low single-digit share of the overall category.
Papad is a 6% business contribution and declined 6.5% in Q1FY27 on early monsoon disrupting handmade production.

timeline.summary: Deepak Agarwal, as Promoter, disclosed holding 18,52,39,398 shares (73.878%) of Bikaji Foods International Limited on March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances during FY 2025-26.
Bikaji Foods disclosed that promoters held 73.88% with zero share encumbrances for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹720.88 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹56.41 Cr.
On May 21, 2026, Bikaji Foods approved an additional US subsidiary investment and a 74% stake acquisition in Jai Barbareek Dev Snacks.
Rahul Joshi, Head – Legal and Company Secretary, shared the earnings conference call audio link for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 22, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST.
Rahul Joshi, Head – Legal and Company Secretary, scheduled Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet on June 01, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. IST in Mumbai, India.
On May 26, 2026, Bikaji Foods filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 22, 2026.

Rahul Joshi, Head – Legal and Company Secretary, confirmed Bikaji Foods International Limited’s one-to-one analyst/institutional investor meetings held in London on June 08, 2026, with no unpublished price-sensitive information shared.
On 6 August 2026 Bikaji's Q1FY27 call reported 12.5% revenue growth and 7.7% volume growth, with FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 13-13.5% including PLI.
Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 scheduled for Friday, November 06, 2026 at 12:00 P.M. IST.

watchlist.response: Dispatches were shut for 3-4 days and labour disruption continued until 18 May, so plants ran at minimal production; June was the highest delivery month and July continued the momentum.
watchlist.text: Why 4-5 days of production outage in April should hit quarterly sales when there were two months to recover and capacity was not fully utilised.

watchlist.response: Category growth slowed to single digits over two years; GST cut from 12% to 5% released inflation and lifted momentum, and the 45-day disruption was the deterring factor this quarter.
watchlist.text: Standalone business grew only about 11% last year versus the earlier 15-17% expectation.

watchlist.response: 15% is a three-year target, not this year's; FY27 will be 13.5% with at least 50 bps improvement year-on-year, and the next two quarters carry heavy festive ad spend.
watchlist.text: How the 13-13.5% FY27 margin guidance ties with 15% plus growth, 2% ad spend and the earlier 15% operating margin aspiration.

watchlist.response: US is a large share of exports and freight is 3x; resolution may take a couple of quarters, but long-term growth is expected from the US and overall export market.
watchlist.text: Whether exports can return to 25-30% growth after the decline.
